visual_goal: Show several sign-up funnels feeding one onboarding orchestrator that uses shared verification, contract and payout services, with only the readiness service deciding bookability.
prompt: A hub-and-spoke illustration. Far left: two entry boxes stacked, a laptop and phone labeled 'Sign-up front ends' and a plug connector labeled 'Activation API'; one arrow from each into a central hub box labeled 'Onboarding orchestrator'. Above the hub, a row of three small service boxes: a shield labeled 'Verification', a signed paper labeled 'Contracts', and a wallet labeled 'Payout accounts'; each receives one short arrow straight up from the hub, and these three boxes have no other arrows. To the right of the hub, at the same height, a larger prominent box with a green switch icon labeled 'Readiness service', receiving one arrow directly from the hub. From 'Readiness service' one arrow to the far right into a box labeled 'Activation events'.
alt: Sign-up front ends and an activation API feeding one onboarding orchestrator, which calls verification, contracts and payout accounts and hands the activation decision to the readiness service.

visual_goal: Show activation as a state machine that runs backwards as well as forwards: Draft, In review, Ready, Bookable, with Suspended and Paused side states and Terminated.
prompt: A state map of six rounded state tiles. Top row, left to right: 'Draft', 'In review', 'Ready', 'Bookable'. One arrow from 'Draft' to 'In review'; one arrow back from 'In review' to 'Draft'; one arrow from 'In review' to 'Ready'; one arrow from 'Ready' to 'Bookable'. Below 'Bookable', an orange tile 'Suspended', with one arrow down from 'Bookable' labeled 'check fails' and one arrow back up to 'Bookable' labeled 'check passes'. Above 'Bookable', a grey tile 'Paused', with one arrow up from 'Bookable' and one arrow back down to 'Bookable'. To the right of 'Suspended', a dark tile 'Terminated', with one arrow from 'Suspended' into it and one arrow from 'Bookable' into it.
alt: Activation states Draft, In review, Ready and Bookable, with Bookable moving to Suspended or Paused and back, and both Bookable and Suspended able to end in Terminated.

visual_goal: Show the Mare Alta bulk migration: 340 listings evaluated under one verified party, 299 ready and 41 blocked, then 37 corrected units ready and 4 still blocked.
prompt: A left-to-right illustration in two stages. First stage: a small PMS server box labeled 'Mare Alta PMS' sends a stack of house cards labeled '340 listings' along one arrow into a gate labeled 'Readiness service'. Out of the gate exactly two arrows: one to a large green pile labeled '299 ready' and one to a smaller orange pile with reason-code tags labeled '41 blocked'. Second stage, further right: from the orange pile one arrow labeled '37 corrected' goes into a second smaller copy of the gate; out of that second gate exactly two arrows: one to a green pile labeled '37 ready' and one to a tiny orange pile labeled '4 still blocked'.
alt: Mare Alta's 340 listings pass through the readiness service: 299 ready and 41 blocked; after corrections, 37 more become ready and 4 stay blocked.
